scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @video-recap/api" "npm run dev -w @video-recap/web"

scripts.check: npm run check -w @video-recap/api && npm run check -w @video-recap/web
scripts.test: npm run schema:check && npm run test -w @video-recap/api && npm run test -w @video-recap/youtube-recap-skill
